corpus.read_from: committed HEAD content via `git show`, not the working tree
corpus.revision_policy: This inventory records no shape-web revision. ADR-016 §3 and §7 keep exact revisions in the external PairCandidate and attestation; a counterpart SHA committed here would be the reciprocal pin §7 exists to prevent. The rows' content hash is what pins it.

executed_subset_note: shape_runnable_gated_candidates is the set book/book-site/scripts/run-book-truth-gate.mjs actually executes (it keeps runnable === true && !deferred). It is a subset of shape_fences, which is itself a subset of fences_all_languages. ADR-016 §6 rejects a percentage over a curated subset, so all three are reported and none is called the universe on its own.

unresolved_gaps.reason: ADR-016 §5 requires every Shape fence to carry a stable explicit identity and §3 forbids line numbers and ordinal positions in it. No fence in the corpus declares an `id=` token, and the committed extractor mints `<slice>__<page-slug>__<position>__L<line>.shape`, which is both. Every Shape fence therefore carries the missing-stable-identity marker.
unresolved_gaps.owner_hint: #116 — minting identities is a Book edit, not an inventory

unresolved_gaps.reason: ADR-016 §5 requires a nonempty reason and an issue or semantic-authority citation on every illustrative fence, and ratchets the set. The corpus expresses non-execution as a bare `runnable=false`, which is the shape §5's rejected-alternatives list names as hiding a broken implementation behind documentation. Every such fence carries the no-illustrative-reason and no-illustrative-citation markers.
unresolved_gaps.owner_hint: #116 — each fence needs a reviewed reason, which is a judgement per fence

unresolved_gaps.reason: ADR-016 §5 requires a negative example to assert a structured diagnostic identity and essential typed payload rather than a mutable rendered sentence. `expected-fail=` is a substring of rendered output, so every fence using it carries the expectation-is-a-rendered-substring marker.
unresolved_gaps.owner_hint: #116, blocked on the ADR-017 / R23 diagnostic catalog supplying stable identities

unresolved_gaps.reason: The harness runs `runnable=true` fences under VM and JIT, and fixture-backed fences under VM only. Those are the modes the harness happens to run, not modes the fence declares, and ADR-016 §5 makes declared modes part of the classification. `declared_modes` therefore records the harness's behaviour, not a fence's claim.
unresolved_gaps.owner_hint: #116 — declaring modes per fence is part of classification

unresolved_gaps.reason: ADR-016 §5 and R15 require a fence claiming native execution to name the exact function or realization and carry a NativeExecutionWitness. No fence-info token expresses that, so a prose native claim in the corpus is invisible to this scan.
unresolved_gaps.owner_hint: #116 plus the R15 / PERF-CLOSURE-NATIVE witness lane
